Description:
This lot includes 9 vintage glass and ceramic telegraph or power line insulators, primarily manufactured by Hemingray. Several pieces are embossed with 'HEMINGRAY' and some show model numbers such as '42' or '45.' The insulators are used and exhibit signs of age, including surface dirt and minor chips. Suitable for collectors, decorators, or those interested in industrial history.
